messages:
Nina (AE): Heads up — TerraCorp pilot ask: they want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (bulk + delta), RBAC mapping to groups, and domain proofing across multiple subdomains. Also a commercial ask: 6mo pilot pricing and SCIM bulk add-on cost. Can SE + security review?
Devon (SE): I'll run the POC infra. Need their IdP metadata and a sample group mapping. SCIM rate limit note: default 60 req/min on hosted; on Dedicated we can bump it. For RBAC mapping we support groups->roles and attribute mapping hooks.
Paul (Customer-Sec): They sent a 30-page vendor risk form. Key asks: attribute filtering on SCIM, provisioning audit trail retention, token/key rotation cadence, and support for signed SCIM payloads. Also they want proof of SOC2 + encryption at rest.
Nina (AE): I'll push the questionnaire back — please call out what details we can supply today. Also they explicitly asked about SLO (single logout) behavior and SP vs IdP initiated flows.
Lucy (Product): We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML. SLO is supported but depends on IdP sessions; we can document caveats. For audit logs, we can stream provisioning events to S3 or their SIEM (syslog). KMS-integrated key rotation is available for Private, and we have rotation API for hosted.
Devon (SE): Proposed POC plan: 1) collect IdP metadata + test account 2) provision a test tenant on Dedicated routing 3) configure SCIM with attribute filter: group.startsWith=terra- 4) run a simulated full import then delta sync. I can run scim-load simulation: `scim-load --users 1000000 --rate 100/s` to validate performance.
Nina (AE): Pricing question from Terra — can we offer a reserved pilot price vs pay-as-you-go? They prefer a 6-month evaluation with committed capacity. @Oliver any play on discounts? :thinking_face:
Oliver (Sales): We can offer a 6mo pilot with reserved capacity discount. Ballpark: 35-40% off Dedicated list if they commit to >=4 GPUs for the pilot. 3mo gets ~20% off. SCIM bulk provisioning add-on is an extra line item priced per 10k users/month — I'll get finance numbers. Need legal to approve pilot terms.
Paul (Customer-Sec): Blocker: Terra insists on per-provisioning audit fields (who/what/when/old_value/new_value) and retention for 2 years. Can we surface that from existing logs?
Lucy (Product): Yes — provisioning events include actor, timestamp, object id, diff payload. Retention can be configured on Dedicated/Private. On hosted we can provide a managed retention tier or export to their storage. I'll compile a compliance packet for the questionnaire.
infra-bot: Uploaded file: Terra_Vendor_Risk_Form_2027.pdf
Nina (AE): Action items summary: Devon -> spin up test tenant + SCIM filter and run load sim; Lucy -> produce compliance packet + SAML/SLO caveats doc; Oliver -> confirm pilot discount with finance & legal; Paul -> list required audit fields to verify logs. I'll share IdP metadata with Devon. Meeting to sync Tue 10am PT.
Devon (SE): Starting tenant creation now. @Nina send IdP metadata to devon@redwood.example or drop link here.
Nina (AE): Uploading metadata link: https://terra.example/idp/metadata.xml — they also included cert chain.
Oliver (Sales): Finance verbal ok for 40% on 6mo pending legal signoff. I'll open an internal approval thread.
Paul (Customer-Sec): Also confirm SCIM supports attribute scoping (e.g., only provision users in group X) and the ability to opt-out certain attrs (like personal email). Terra requires PII minimization.
Devon (SE): SCIM filters and attribute mapping are supported; we can drop attrs server-side. For high-volume provisioning we'll use chunked imports and continuous delta; advise enabling prefix/KV caching for reduced token costs during evaluation.
Lucy (Product): I'll attach the SAML + SCIM architecture note shortly. For domain proofing: wildcard verification is possible once per account; multiple explicit DNS TXT proves needed for separate tenant-claimed domains.
Nina (AE): Terra also asked if we can provide a short-term SLA for pilot latency. Can we commit a 99% P99 latency for the pilot on Dedicated?
Devon (SE): We can commit to latency SLOs on Dedicated capacity; exact numbers depend on instance size and model. For text generation baseline we typically hit ~P99 300–500ms on 2x A100 equiv for short prompts. I'll capture measured numbers in the POC report.
Paul (Customer-Sec): One more blocker: their legal needs a data processing addendum for SCIM data mapping. Legal will need sample DPA text.
Oliver (Sales): I'll loop Legal and attach a draft DPA.
Nina (AE): Perfect. I'll follow up with Terra to confirm the scope and send the questionnaire answers by EOD Mon. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Lucy (Product): Draft doc posted: SAML-SCIM-Compliance-v1.md (will link here once uploaded).
Devon (SE): Ping when metadata is updated. I'll post initial perf numbers in thread when sim completes.
Nina (AE): Closing notes — primary contacts: Terra SRE = j.chen@terra.example, IdP admin = s.kumar@terra.example. Reconvene Tue 10am PT.
